x: It is with sincere regret that we record the passing of Bert Clayton at the early age of 39 years; and our heartfelt sympathy is extended to his Wife and three children.
In the early stages, Jack Bidgood Bert Clayton, Jack Baker, Jack Wakeley and George Oliver, walked in a group with Don Heath and Joe Wilson not far away.
Bert Clayton, our new member resident at Eastleigh, gave another good display of walking in finishing eleventh. He will undoubtedly prove a great asset when he qualifies for our teams.
